name: Ashcroft-Nwosu Collective
description: A recently emerged underground production house specializing in geneware and augmentation-rights neural content that falls outside Sable Charter licensing parameters. Founded by a former HelixCorp geneware research technician and a Tier 2 filmmaker whose license was revoked in 2213, the Collective produces content that depicts unauthorized augmentation procedures, geneware self-modification, and synthetic personhood in ways that are explicitly illegal under current corponation bioethics codes. Their work circulates primarily in Tier 1-2 underground networks.
cultural_impact: Brought sophisticated neural-feed production values to underground bioethics content for the first time, bridging the gap between crude the Gray Zone-made content and the corporate polish that makes immersive storytelling emotionally effective.
story_hooks: The founding technician has been taken by HelixCorp retrieval and the filmmaker is asking the underground network for extraction help
Ashcroft-Nwosu's latest production contains what appears to be genuine HelixCorp proprietary research data embedded in the narrative — someone inside HelixCorp is feeding them information

A Tier 3 journalist wants to break the story of the Collective's existence, which would expose them to corponation enforcement — but the journalist claims it would also give them protection through public visibility
